title: Chapter 53: Host'S Talent
content:
Chapter 53: Host'S Talent

Wu Qing and Meng led the Tiger Cavalry back to the battlefield. The situation on the battlefield had been completely reversed, and the Zerg had an absolute advantage.

The few thousand remaining soldiers of the Bugbear clan were surrounded by the Zerg and huddled in a small area in the middle.

After the berserk bugbear infantry quickly exhausted their own energy, they have now ended their berserk transformation and lost their combat effectiveness.

Many of the over-exhausted bugbear infantry fell to the ground and died after going berserk.

The cost of this kind of madness is very high, killing eight hundred enemies and damaging one thousand.

It will not be used lightly unless absolutely necessary.

The enemies gathered together became the best targets for the Hydralisk.

"It seems that the battle is about to end!"

Now Meng came with the Tiger Cavalry. Faced with such a defeated army, he also lost interest in continuing to fight.

Fighting such remnant soldiers is not in line with Meng's character.

Meng and his tiger cavalry watched as the Zerg swept away the fallen leaves with the autumn wind, clearing away the remnants of the Bugbear clan on the battlefield.

"Haha, Wu Qing! I feel more confident now!"

"With the support of you and the Zerg, the alliance we formed is sure to gain a foothold in this area!"

Mengzai truly saw the performance of Wu Qing and the Zerg on the battlefield, and the remaining worry in his heart disappeared.

"Now that the battle is over, the rest will be left to you."

Wu Qing smiled.

"Don't worry, let me roar, and we'll get the alliance done tomorrow!"

He rode the giant tiger away from Wu Qing, took a deep breath, and shouted around the battlefield.

"You little mice, you've seen everything you need to see!"

"Get back here quickly! Tell your lord to come to my Tiger Territory early tomorrow morning!"

"Just say that this matter is related to the life and death of each territory! If you don't come, you will be responsible for the consequences!"

The fierce sound is loud and penetrating, and the sound can travel a long distance.

There were many scouts from other territories around, and maybe there were also scouts from the Tengu clan mixed in. When they heard the fierce shouting, they all left quickly.

"Didn't you send people to send personal letters to each territory? Do you still need to shout like this?"

Wu Qing was puzzled and asked.

"If you don't shout here, they don't know the seriousness of the matter. If you shout like this, the lords who have received the invitation will definitely come to Tiger Leader tomorrow."

Meng also understood Wu Qing's worries and further explained: "As for the Tengu clan, they will know everything they need to know, so there is no need to worry."

"Under the current situation, our alliance has no problem protecting itself."

"For the Tengu clan to have more strength to counter the army of evil god believers, it is a great thing that they can only dream of."

"As for the future, as long as we are strong enough, we are not even afraid of the evil god's army. What else are we afraid of them for?"

He may look rough, but in fact he is delicate and thoughtful, not as careless as he looks on the outside.

It is precisely because of this that he was able to develop his Tiger Territory to what it is today.

"I always feel that the Tengu clan is a trouble. When you say this, I feel relieved."

Wu Qing is actually fearless in his heart. His performance is just the need of the character.

"Haha, if you want to do something, trouble will never stop!"

"Wu Qing, since you have been born, you must be mentally prepared for this!"

"We will deal with the troubles in the future later. The most important thing now is to strengthen ourselves!"

"After this battle, your Daxia leader's luck will definitely increase greatly. Please seize the time and develop your territory!"

Meng was a little envious of Wu Qing's gains in this war, but he was not jealous.

The Tiger Territory gained part of the harvest without any losses, while the Great Xia Territory's gains were obtained in exchange for countless Zerg lives.

But he didn't know that the biggest gain from this war, the luck directly plundered from the enemy, had been absorbed by the system. The luck that Daxia could share was actually not much.

The luck Daxia Ling received may only be the luck caused by indirect influences.

Of course, if necessary, the system's Qi resources can be directly converted into Daxia Territory's Qi luck.

At present, the resources of the system should still be mainly focused on the development of the Zerg. The Daxia Territory is just a supplement to the development of the Zerg, and the priorities must be clearly distinguished.

As for how the territory can be developed by luck, Wu Qing is still confused. He still needs to learn from Meng.

The puppies ended the battle, and Wu Qing asked most of the assembled puppies to disperse. Some of them went to carry out larger-scale reconnaissance missions, and some were responsible for security tasks in the Zerg activity area.

A large number of Zerg worker bees are coming, and they are coming to clean up the battlefield.

"Meng, the trophies on the battlefield, what do you need?"

Wu Qing asked Meng for his opinion.

"We don't want anything! We've earned our luck for nothing, so how dare we ask for something!"

Meng firmly refused.

"Then you're welcome. My Daxia has taken in a group of refugees and is expanding. Now we are short of everything."

Wu Qing smiled.

"You want your men to do statistics and see what is missing. We, the Tiger Leader, must give us good support!"

"Thank you so much!"

While the two were talking, a large number of Zerg worker bees rushed to the battlefield and began to skillfully clean up the items left on the battlefield.

"Finally, we saw a new group of Zerg. Zerg is a collective name, right? It should be divided into many groups?"

Meng saw the strange worker bee and couldn't help but ask.

"Yes, the Zerg race is divided into many groups, and these are the only ones that have been born for the time being."

Wu Qing nodded in response.

"I always feel like I'm overlooking something! It feels weird!"

He was chatting fiercely about the Zerg population problem, and suddenly realized that he seemed to have overlooked something, but he couldn't remember it for a while.

At this time, he inadvertently looked up at the sky, staring intently at the floating host not far from the battlefield.

"Wu Qing! What are these giant things floating in the sky? Why can they interfere with my perception and memory?"

The host stared fiercely at the sky, fearing that in the blink of an eye he would forget what he saw!

"This is the host of the Zerg. Their spiritual power is very strong and they are naturally able to reduce their own sense of existence. This is a talent for their self-preservation."

"They have always been there, and all enemies, including the priest, have ignored its existence."

Wu Qing explained with a smile.

This ability of the host was only recently discovered by Wu Qing. He found that in the several battles the host participated in, no enemy paid attention to them, which felt a little strange.

When flying objects as big as the host come to the battlefield, the enemy should focus on guarding against them, but the enemies seem to turn a blind eye to them.

Wu Qing only found out about the host's ability after asking the insect queen.

This setting is more reasonable in reality, otherwise a host without attack means would have only one way to escape when encountering an enemy, which would be too passive.

"What an amazing ability! I can actually turn a blind eye when such a big thing flies overhead!"

"I didn't know the Zerg could bring those surprises and scares!"

Meng finally saw the various abilities of the Zerg that emerged one after another.

"Of course there are many more, I will slowly adapt to them in the future."

Wu Qing smiled.
